findings.passage: We face an unacceptable epidemic of gun violence, with school and mass shootings happening in places that should be safe. Some of this comes from the mistaken idea that gun safety laws will take away everyone’s guns. Some of it is because politicians are afraid to stand up to the gun industry and tell them the truth: they need to take more responsibility, like everyone else, to keep our communities and state safe.
findings.note: From her e-newsletter. She describes gun violence as an epidemic and says gun safety laws are wrongly thought to take away guns.

findings.passage: My bill, HB 5760 (2026), would end immunity for the gun industry by allowing victims and cities to sue gun makers in state court when appropriate. No industry should be completely protected from the consequences of acting illegally or carelessly.
findings.note: From her e-newsletter. She describes her own bill that lets victims and cities sue gun makers.
HB 5760 (2026), introduced by her, abolishes firearm manufacturer immunity from liability to local units of government (amends MCL 28.435). Referred to Government Operations the same day.
